solution.html:
#include <stdio.h>

void print_numbers(const char *expression) {
    int stack[1024], top = -1, next = 0, first = 1;
    for (int i = 0; expression[i] != '\0'; ++i) {
        int value;
        if (expression[i] == '(') {
            if (top == 1023) return;
            value = ++next;
            stack[++top] = value;
        } else if (expression[i] == ')') {
            if (top == -1) return;
            value = stack[top--];
        } else continue;
        printf("%s%d", first ? "" : " ", value);
        first = 0;
    }
    printf("\n");
}

ch=exp[i];
if(ch!='+' && ch!='-' && ch!='*' && ch!='/') {

    op2=pop(&s);

    switch(ch) {
    case '-': push(&s,op1-op2); break;
    case '/': push(&s,op1/op2); break;
    }
}
